# Skills WEDO

> AI 能力提升實戰與 Skills 快速上手。Skills WEDO 是繁體中文 AI Skills 入門平台，協助初學者理解 SKILL.md 工作流、挑選推薦 Skills、安裝與使用 Skills，並建立自己的 AI 工作流。

## What This Page Answers

- What AI Skills are, and how they differ from one-off prompts, MCP tools, and project rules.
- How beginners can choose, install, use, update, and maintain Skills.
- Which public starter Skills are useful for common beginner workflows.
- How to turn repeated work into a maintainable `SKILL.md` workflow.

## Definition

An AI Skill is a reusable workflow package. Its core file is usually `SKILL.md`, and it may include references, scripts, templates, and assets. A good Skill describes when it should be used, which steps the AI should follow, what output is expected, and how the result should be verified.

## Recommended Beginner Path

1. Start with a small set of high-frequency Skills.
2. Practice one prompt at a time instead of pasting all prompts at once.
3. Add your own source material after the starter prompt.
4. Ask the AI to explain how it will use the Skill before it starts.
5. Convert repeated prompts into your own `SKILL.md`.
